Intro: I'm sorry, young cook. I heard the rumors. They spread like flies… I wish I could've met the good doctor myself, before the curses took him.
Even the strongest fish can drown in the storm. It is why I remain steadfast. I promised my grandfather I would see my people to justice.
In such dark times, we are blessed to tread ever forward. So, a [DISH], and a hail to you, for being strong for all of us, and for a new Mogara!
Success: Yes! Incredible work, young cook! Until next time.
Fail: Ah. Sorrow is a fuel for strength, but a bitter oil for cooking. Don't worry, I completely understand, my friend.
Reject: Oh… dear. I understand now. What really happened to the doctor? Did the Spoilage take him, or did rotten beasts like you pull the trigger!?
